name: antigravity
description: Delegate the reading to Gemini, keep the judgement on Claude. A local MCP server (shipped in this plugin) digests a codebase, runs read-only tasks over files, reviews a diff with a second model family, and reads recordings and long documents — the files never enter Claude's context, only a digest with file:line references does. Model choice lives in an alias table the organisation controls; requests leave the machine only to hosts on an egress allowlist (Vertex AI by default).

coding_policy.title: Inject routing policy at session start
coding_policy.description: When on, a SessionStart hook injects this plugin's cost-aware routing policy (read through the delegation server above the break-even, keep Claude's context lean, always verify the digest) as session context, so the discipline applies without invoking the skill. Set to off/false/0/no to suppress.

delegation_nudge.title: Nudge delegation on bulk-looking prompts
delegation_nudge.description: When on, a UserPromptSubmit hook adds a short advisory note to Claude's context when a prompt looks like bulk reading above the delegation break-even. Advisory only — Claude still makes the break-even judgment per task. Set to off/false/0/no to suppress.

usage_log.title: Delegation usage log (JSONL)
usage_log.description: Absolute path. A PostToolUse hook appends one line per delegation call joining Claude's session id with the server's usage (tokens, model, alias, endpoint, latency). Counts only, no content. Empty = ~/.antigravity-usage.jsonl. measure-session.py --join reads it.
